abilities.name: Shockwave
abilities.description: AOE blast around the player that pushes enemies back and destroys enemy projectiles.

abilities.name: Overcharge
abilities.description: Weapon fires at double rate and double projectiles for a short burst.

abilities.name: Blink
abilities.description: Instant short-range teleport in your movement direction.

abilities.name: Shield
abilities.description: Blocks all damage for a short duration but prevents attacking.

abilities.name: Decoy
abilities.description: Drop a copy that distracts enemies while you briefly vanish.

abilities.name: Turret
abilities.description: Place an auto-firing turret that tracks nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Minefield
abilities.description: Drop a spread of mines that detonate on enemy contact.

abilities.name: Orbit
abilities.description: Summon orbiting projectiles that damage enemies on contact.
